source_snapshot.procedure: Retrieve the UBB FRU Product Info Area through supported in-band and/or out-of-band methods and include the tool/method and output in the report.
source_snapshot.criteria: Both in-band and out-of-band must be available, and results must be human-readable.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes in-band ipmitool plus an unspecified Redfish equivalent, but grep-only output and insecure SSH cannot prove exact UBB identity or field parity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CHANGED; requires exact UBB-to-IPMI/Redfish mapping, endpoint identity, read-only access and raw field comparison.

old_problem: The active review treated the target's IPMI FRU ID and Redfish URI as an engineering decision. DMTF defines a standard read-only Assembly model and its identity fields; actual resource IDs and endpoint credentials are discoverable runtime parameters. The source already defines the acceptance rule: both paths must be available and readable.
disposition_reason: The UBB physical serial/part label anchors identity. In-band FRU inventory can discover the matching IPMI record, while the Redfish service/chassis inventory can discover the matching Assembly member or vendor-supported read-only FRU resource. DMTF Assembly defines Vendor/Producer, Model, PartNumber, SerialNumber, SKU, Version and related fields. ED-03 permits endpoint/resource bindings and forbids guessing them; their absence before execution does not keep the review pending. Both independent paths and human-readable field parity remain mandatory.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row417 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3009, same-code row151 SGEMM and adjacent row418 UFM case.
Kept same-code row151 SGEMM coverage separate from this read-only UBB FRU retrieval case.
Applied DMTF Redfish Assembly semantics for assembly identity and product fields, while retaining full IPMI FRU Product Info output in-band.
Converted IPMI FRU ID, BMC endpoint and Redfish resource URI to runtime-discovered, serial-anchored parameters rather than guessed constants.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row418 and verified its manifest identity; no IPMI, Redfish or DUT/BMC query ran.

test_case.test_name: UBB FRU Product Info dual-path availability, readability and identity parity
test_case.purpose: Prove the exact physical UBB's product information is retrievable and human-readable through both approved in-band IPMI and out-of-band BMC/Redfish paths, and that shared identity fields describe the same assembly.
required_package: `ipmitool` with in-band IPMI device access and recorded version/status
BMC endpoint/certificate/firmware, least-privilege Redfish credentials and service-root/chassis inventory access
Physical/project UBB identity anchor: chassis/slot plus serial and part number
Supported Redfish Assembly resource or vendor-documented read-only OOB FRU endpoint when Assembly is not implemented
test_case.test_command: Record the target chassis/slot and physical UBB serial/part label. In-band, capture unfiltered `ipmitool fru` inventory, select the record whose stable identity matches the UBB, then capture `ipmitool fru print <discovered_fru_id>` with stderr/status. Out-of-band, securely enumerate Redfish service root and Chassis resources, follow the matching chassis `Assembly` link and select the assembly by serial/part/location; if absent, use only the BMC vendor's documented read-only UBB FRU URI. Preserve full HTTP status/headers/body. Render both raw records into a human-readable field table and compare shared manufacturer/vendor, product/model, part, serial and version fields.
test_case.expected_result: Both independent read paths succeed against the same physical UBB, return complete nonempty Product/Assembly information and render readable field names/values. Stable shared identity fields match exactly after documented whitespace/encoding normalization; neither response describes another chassis, GPU, PSU or board.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires status-successful unfiltered evidence from both paths, serial/part/location proof that each maps to the UBB, readable Product Info and equality of all shared stable fields. One path only, a grep excerpt, guessed resource, authentication failure, empty/placeholder values or identity mismatch cannot pass.
safety_gate: Read-only commands and HTTP GET only; do not invoke FRU write, PATCH, POST, reset or OEM mutation
Validate BMC certificate/endpoint and chassis identity; keep credentials out of logs and command history
Discover resource IDs from inventories and match stable identity; never assume FRU 0 or a fixed Redfish URI
Preserve full raw evidence and stop on identity mismatch, unsupported schema or unexpected write requirement; never auto-retry with broader privilege
expected_evidence: Physical/project UBB chassis/slot/serial/part identity and BMC firmware/certificate
ipmitool version, full FRU inventory, selected ID rationale, full Product Info output and status
Redfish service/chassis discovery, exact resource URI, schema/@odata type, HTTP status and full response
Human-readable normalized field-parity table with raw-value references
Access logs without secrets and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected. On missing resource, access failure or mismatch, preserve both raw responses and stop for BMC/platform mapping correction; do not write FRU data, change privileges, reset BMC or substitute another assembly.

source_conflict.reason: DeepSeek preserves dual-path intent but leaves the OOB resource and full identity evidence incomplete.

blocked.reason: Standards define a safe discovery/read method; unsupported OOB exposure becomes an execution failure or project implementation gap, not missing review logic.

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Data Model — Assembly
external_authorities.applied_rule: Assembly represents a device assembly and exposes read-only vendor/producer, model, part, serial, SKU, version and original-data information at chassis and device Assembly URIs.

project_authority: BMC implementation, endpoint access and exact UBB resource IDs remain runtime/project bindings; they do not alter the dual-path availability and field-parity acceptance rule.
